# Unknown visitor alerts onboarding and commit (2026-03-09 16:53Z)

_**User**_

Wenn das Gerät ein Location-Update verschickt, soll bei aktivierter Funktion zusätzlich die Visitor-History geprüft werden. Danach wurde ein vollständiger Plan für einen Unknown-Visitor-Alarm mit Onboarding-Seite, Permission-Flow, Trigger-Integration, 24h-Cooldown, Foreground-Notification und Voll-Lokalisierung vorgegeben und zur Implementierung freigegeben.

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_

Implemented the full Phase-1 scope in app code, onboarding/settings UI, localization, and tests.

Key actions performed:
- Added `UnknownVisitorAlertService` with centralized permission handling, watermark-based visitor processing, filtering, cooldown, and local notification scheduling.
- Added trigger hooks after successful direct location submit and after successful outbox flush delivery.
- Added new onboarding page for unknown-visitor alerts and wired it only into full onboarding flow (tracking-dependent).
- Added settings toggle flow with denied-state handling and app-settings CTA.
- Enabled foreground presentation handling through `UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate`.
- Added/validated localization keys across all 10 app locales.
- Added unit tests for evaluator/permission flow and localization completeness.
- Updated onboarding image on request to use `yourlocationyourcontrol`.
- Prepared documentation updates and changelog entry for `3.1.3`.
